Eight activity requests are explicitly researcher-authored prospective conditions, not historical user messages; phase availability cannot retrospectively fix old experiments.
22 actions and 44 arm documents contain eight decision-supervision positions derived from five principles across six source families; these are not 44 professional decisions.
Shared builder is CPU-verified, not integrated into a newly executed live rollout. Existing closed runners/results are unchanged.
Per-task query-tool availability remains unchanged. No no-edit or rejected-call training targets were added.
Decision/action arm adds 1332 supervised decision tokens. This is not a matched-material separate-versus-paired mechanism comparison.
Tensor consumption used the actual Dataset/Trainer normalization path with fixture logits and intercepted backward; no real-model forward, backward, optimizer, GPU use or native scene execution.
Source rights, physical mobility, independent professional quality and cross-project generalization remain limited by existing source/evaluation records.
